text: Please accept this letter as my request for your support seeking the installation of All Way Stop Controls (stop signs) on the streets and at the intersections noted below. In all instances, these requests are the result of serious concerns expressed by parents of children attending nearby schools (Corvette Public School and Walter Perry Public School). These have been studied previously by Transportation Services staff and although they did not meet the technical warrants, the serious concerns of parents and school staff with respect to young children crossing these streets without the presence of A WSC's requires this action. Motorists using the streets along which these schools are situated are driving in such a manner as to pose safety concerns for the children. It is clear that the presence of A WSC's would contribute significantly to the safety of the students crossing these…
